================================================================================
generic instantiation
================================================================================
Foo<ref Bar> foo = new Foo<ref Bar>(); 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit
	(decl_variable
		(type_identifier
			(identifier)
			(types (type_ref (type_identifier (identifier)))))
		(identifier)
		(new
			(type_identifier
				(identifier)
				(types (type_ref (type_identifier (identifier)))))
			(actual_parameters))))


================================================================================
autoptr type argument
================================================================================
array<autoptr X> m = new array<autoptr X>();
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit
	(decl_variable
		type: (type_identifier
			(identifier)
			(types
				(type_identifier (identifier))))
		name: (identifier)
		init: (new
			type: (type_identifier
				(identifier)
				(types
					(type_identifier (identifier))))
			(actual_parameters))))
